28 November 2025

## Circular to management companies of SFC-authorised unit trusts and mutual funds

## Updated streamlined measures on post-authorisation matters for SFC-authorised UCITS   funds

1. The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) regularly reviews its operational processes and guidance to ensure their efficiency without compromising investor interests and protection.
2. The SFC has further streamlined measures for processing certain post-authorisation matters for UCITS funds 1 , following its review and engagement with market participants. These measures aim at facilitating UCITS funds in implementing changes that are subject to their home regulator's supervision, and will take immediate effect.

## Further streamlined measures for UCITS funds

3. The key streamlined measures cover the following post-authorisation matters:
2. (i) Change of key operators - Removing the SFC's requirement on prior approval for change of depository and investment delegates which are under the home regulator's supervision.
3. (ii) Material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions -Removing the SFC's requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund's home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.
4. (iii) Post-authorisation notifications - To align the SFC's notification requirements with the fund's home jurisdiction requirements, including the notice periods and content requirements.
4. The SFC has updated and published on its website relevant FAQs 2 , including a revamped FAQ on SFC Authorization of UCITS Funds to facilitate UCITS fund managers in navigating post-authorisation compliance matters, as well as related forms and checklists 3 .

1 For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands, and (ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.

[2 Please refer to https://www.sfc.hk/en/faqs/Publicly-offered-investment-products](https://www.sfc.hk/en/faqs/Publicly-offered-investment-products)

[3 Please refer to https://www.sfc.hk/en/Forms/products/Investment-products-Forms-and-checklists](https://www.sfc.hk/en/Forms/products/Investment-products-Forms-and-checklists)

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

## Implementation

5. The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).
6. Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.

## Obligation of management companies

7. The SFC will continue to conduct post-vetting of scheme changes (including those not subject to the SFC's prior approval) and related revised documents filed with the SFC. It may make follow-up enquiries and/or take appropriate regulatory actions in case of non-compliance to ensure investor protection.
8. Should you wish to clarify any aspects of this circular, please contact the relevant case officers in charge.
